mentions.name: AI storyboard-to-video workflow
mentions.description: This AI workflow generates storyboards for short stories using image generation and editing models, then automates turning them into videos with video generation models. The builder documents the workflow development in a blog and is exploring it as a new way of visual storytelling and personal and product branding, with no plans to commercialize it.
mentions.source_excerpt: you can generate storyboards for short stories, and automate the creation of these as videos with video generation models. This is a topic that interests me heavily, and as such I am now building my own workflows around that.
